summary: Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature across rich/align.py, rich/tree.py, rich/console.py, CHANGELOG.md, tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py. Changes: Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative stack walk, 4 cells per indent level); VerticalCenter class with render, measure and repr; Align.__repr__; Align rendering constrains the wrapped renderable to its measured maximum (or the smaller of that and an explicit width); Console.print render options use justify="default". CHANGELOG 9.8.0 marked Unreleased with an Added section. New tests cover Align/VerticalCenter repr, VerticalCenter render and measure, tall-content no-padding, Align width centering, and Tree measurement (11, 19). Tests were NOT run (per instructions), so everything is verified by reading only. Watch for shifts in existing auto-width Align output, and confirm that console.print adds no extra newline in the VerticalCenter render test.
